purpose: describe predictive performance only after source calibration and preparation-model compatibility are established
split_unit: biological axon, never randomly split trials of same axon across fit and test
model_required: coupled sodium gating and pH/temperature mechanism matching alkaline perfused squid preparation, with complete equations/parameters/source
calibration_policy: No optimizing conversion gains against voltage/model performance. Resolve or explicitly bound hardware calibration independently. Exclude disputed pulse trials from accuracy scoring until clarified.
initialization: preserve measured absolute voltage; any gating initialization/burn-in must be prospectively specified using pre-stimulus data only
metrics: all-trace voltage RMSE and MAE with absolute physical units
positive 0mV crossings with one-to-one match within +/-1ms, report precision/recall and counts
spike latency, peak voltage and after-hyperpolarization, each reported separately
uncertainty: report separately by axon and protocol; four axons do not establish population-wide accuracy
no_preset_biological_success_threshold: Do not reuse the 0.1mV engineering solver threshold as a physiological validation threshold. No release approval inferred from a numerical score.
why_not_executed: required preparation-model parameters and calibration are unavailable in verified sources so far
